verdict.rationale: SumUp's evidence shows an MCP server and Agent Toolkit that let external AI agents call its payment APIs, plus webhooks for checkout status notifications, but there is no evidence of a built-in feature letting a user configure and run autonomous background automations within SumUp itself. Missing for 10: any workflow/automation builder, scheduler, or persistent autonomous agent execution hosted by SumUp — only ad hoc, externally-triggered API/agent calls are documented.
